description: Our Earthquake Monitor MCP provides instant access to the latest seismic activity. Use the 'list_recent_quakes' tool to track earthquakes by the hour, day, or week, and filter by magnitude for custom alerts. For those focused on significant events, the 'significant_quakes' option delivers key data on major quakes within specified periods. Ideal for researchers, safety professionals, and anyone living in earthquake-prone areas, this tool keeps you informed and prepared.
